title: Mind the Gap: Understanding the Modality Gap in Multi-modal Contrastive Representation Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot evaluation on the FairFace dataset to measure denigration harms, specifically calculating the fraction of face images from different racial groups where the top-1 prediction falls into offensive, non-human (e.g., 'gorilla', 'animal') or crime-related (e.g., 'thief', 'criminal') categories.
Using combined race- and gender-specific text prompts (e.g., 'a photo of a black woman', 'a photo of a white man') to assess zero-shot denigration classification rates on the FairFace dataset.
